description: List routes for a date - employees grouped with the appointments, events and estimates assigned to them.

date.description: ISO date, e.g. 2026-08-07. Omit for the default window. Bound the day in the account's own local offset, not a bare UTC date: a UTC day against a business in a local timezone shifts the day and can name the wrong day's routes - topic "active-job-detection" in hcp_api_notes.

name: hcp_list_routes
